name: claude-code-stuff
description: Justin Pearson's personal Claude Code marketplace: prompts, skills, and setup helpers for configuring Claude Code.

plugins.name: statusline-setup
plugins.description: Deprecated: superseded by session-info-in-footer. Installs a multi-line Claude Code status line (model, effort, context, cost, git branch and status, plugin counts) for the terminal.

plugins.name: screen-recording-demo
plugins.description: Short, silent, privacy-safe screen-recording demo videos and GIFs of a tool on macOS, with a moving cursor, title cards, and numbered captions.

plugins.name: session-info-in-footer
plugins.description: A two-line band above the prompt, in the terminal and the desktop app: model, effort, context left, session cost, prompt-cache expiry with a warning, clock, directory, and repo.
